title: Bookings
description: Book a place at a Creative Rein event, or get in touch about Home-Ed Club, alternative provision, Little Rein Club, pony parties and gift vouchers.

sections.heading: Book with Creative Rein
sections.lede: Choose an event below and click Book a place to reserve your spot. You'll get a confirmation email once you've booked.

image.alt: A brown and white pony with its nose in a bucket, next to saddles and red rugs in the tack room

sections.heading: Everything else: ask us
sections.text: Home-Ed Club, alternative provision, Little Rein Club, pony parties and gift vouchers are arranged with us directly. Tell us your child's age, what they enjoy and anything we should know.
